gaps.sentence: We need ___ proof before we can act (CONCLUDE).
gaps.explanation: An adjective is needed before 'proof': conclusive (-ive). 'Conclusion' is the noun.

gaps.sentence: The ___ of the new bridge will take two years (CONSTRUCT).
gaps.hint: noun needed as subject of the sentence
gaps.explanation: The subject needs a noun: construction (the -tion noun); 'constructive' is an adjective.

gaps.sentence: The audience found the lecture extremely ___ (BORE).
gaps.explanation: The lecture causes boredom, so it is boring; the audience would be bored.

gaps.sentence: The company is a major ___ (EMPLOY) in the region.
gaps.hint: the company gives jobs — it is the one who employs
gaps.explanation: An employer gives work; an employee receives it. The sentence is about the company.

gaps.sentence: She showed great ___ (PATIENT) with the children.
gaps.hint: noun needed; beware the similar word meaning 'people in hospital'
gaps.explanation: 'Patience' is the noun (show patience); 'patients' are people receiving medical care.

gaps.sentence: New technology has ___ the way we work (REVOLUTION).
gaps.explanation: The suffix -ise forms the verb: revolutionise. After 'has' the past participle 'revolutionised' is needed.

gaps.sentence: He ___ denied knowing anything about the plan (FIRM).
gaps.explanation: An adverb modifies the verb 'denied': firmly. Note the doubled m before -ly.
